<?php
class RefBacking133 {
    public $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "A:";
$object = new RefBacking133;
$alias =& $object->value; // READ
echo $alias === 7 ? "alias7|" : "bad-alias|";
$alias = "8";
echo $alias === "8" ? "untyped8|" : "bad-type|";
$copy = $object->value; // COPY_READ
$alias = 9;
echo $copy === "8" ? "copy8|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $alias === 9 ? "alias9|" : "bad-write|";
unset($object);
$alias = "free";
echo $alias === "free" ? "free|" : "bad-source|";
echo $copy === "8" ? "copy-still8|Z|" : "bad-copy-after|";

<?php
class RefRebind133 {
    public $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "R:";
$object = new RefRebind133;
$replacement = 11;
try {
    $object->value =& $replacement; // REBIND
    echo "bad-rebind|";
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage() === "Cannot assign by reference to overloaded object" ? "blocked|" : "bad-message|";
    echo $error->getLine() === 12 ? "line|" : "bad-line|";
    echo $error->getFile() === __FILE__ ? "file|" : "bad-file|";
}
echo $object->value === 7 ? "kept7|" : "bad-property|"; // COPY_READ
$replacement = 13;
echo $object->value === 7 ? "separate7|" : "bad-rebound|";
echo $replacement === 13 ? "rhs13|" : "bad-rhs|";
unset($object);
echo "Z|";

<?php
class RefNull133 {
    public $value {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "N:";
$object = new RefNull133;
$alias =& $object->value;
echo $alias === null ? "null|" : "bad-null|";
$alias = "first";
$copy = $object->value;
$alias = "second";
echo $copy === "first" ? "copy|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $alias === "second" ? "alias|" : "bad-alias|";
unset($object);
$alias = "after";
echo $alias === "after" ? "after|Z|" : "bad-after|";
